name: code-block
title: Code Block
summary: Code to read and copy: a listing with line numbers, a diff or a command.
description: Code to read and copy: a listing with line numbers, a diff, or a command. A light editor panel: a line-numbered listing, or a unified diff with one gutter, a green / red accent bar and row tint, plus word-level add / del highlights. Both share syntax colouring, insets and wrapping (wrap; off in the editor look, where the body scrolls sideways). The editor look is the bare body of an editor pane: no frame, no header, no copy. Copy puts the code on the clipboard and says so for 1.5s.

anatomy.description: Card, max-width 420; editor: no frame, fills its container

44px: icon · filename · copy | stat. With files the same 44px row is the tabs' header part: file tabs · path · copy, or, when the tabs do not fit, pager · select · path · copy. Not rendered in the editor look
Cut in the middle while it does not fit (a file name keeps its end: "invoice-batch-…-scheduler.ts"), full name in title while cut (lib/truncate.ts middleTruncation)

A Button (ghost, xs, rounded, muted) with two labels in one cell (icon part: copy and check; label part: Copy and Copied); data-swapped while "Copied" shows; aria-label "Copy code". Its green while swapped is the code block's. Beside it a visually hidden role=status (sr-only) announces "Copied". The real Button, marked data-code-block="copy"; swapped while Copied shows.
Visually hidden role=status beside Copy; says Copied while the button is swapped.

Scrolls past --fndn-code-block-max-height; while it overflows it is a focusable role=region named by the filename Height: --fndn-code-block-height (height prop) fixes it; --fndn-code-block-max-height (maxHeight) caps it.
Grid: gutter (as wide as the widest number) + code; rows are subgrids
data-type=ctx|add|del in the diff. The current line (currentLine) is tinted and carries aria-current="true".
3px accent bar: green, or red hatch
Line number: right-aligned on the gutter edge, not selectable

With files: the active file's path in the header row, pushed to the end before Copy; mono, xs, ink-2; the first thing to shrink, cut in the middle so the file name stays ("packages/…/select.tsx"), full path in title while cut; hidden while the pager and the select stand in for the tabs (the select names the file)
With files, while the tabs do not fit (data-fit="select" on the root): the pager component (loop, "2 of 5", Previous file / Next file) in the header, before the select

With files, while the tabs do not fit: the select component (sm, subtle) listing every file by its label, its value cut in the middle when it does not fit; it and the pager stand in for the hidden tab list (and the path) and go once the tabs fit again
variant=command: the one row — the code (scrolls sideways) and a trailing copy

variant.description: code: line-numbered listing. diff: unified diff. command: one line to copy (an install command): no header, no line numbers, copy at the end.

filename.description: The file's name in the header, and the name of the scroll region.

lines.description: Listing lines for the code variant

code.description: Raw text placed on the clipboard; defaults to lines joined

maxHeight.description: Body height (px) past which the code scrolls

labels.description: { copy, copied, copyCode, files, file, previousFile, nextFile }

highlighted.description: Lines already highlighted elsewhere (shiki and the like), as trusted HTML, one string per line; shown instead of lines (Copy still takes code or lines).

files.description: Files as tabs (the tabs component, underline, inHeader) in one 44px header row: the tabs at the start, their underline resting on the header's hairline, then the active file's path and the block's one Copy (it copies the active file), placed as in a single file's header. The panels hold only the body. The path shrinks first (cut in the middle). Names of choices are shown whole: when the tabs do not fit beside Copy (measured on mount and on every change of width, code-block.logic.ts), the root takes data-fit="select", the tab list is hidden and a pager plus a select of every file stand in for it; the tabs come back once they fit.

file.description: The active file's path (defaults to the first).

height.description: Fixed body height in px: the box keeps its size whatever the code (loading, switching files).

fill.description: Fill the container's height, as an editor pane does: the block is a column as tall as its parent (give the parent a height), the header keeps its 44px and the body takes the rest and scrolls; no max width. Nothing is measured: it is layout, so it follows every resize. Not for the command variant.

currentLine.description: The current line, 1-based (an editor's caret line, a line a link points to): its row is tinted (hover) across the gutter and the code, its number turns ink, and it carries aria-current="true". In the code variant and the active file; a diff ignores it. It is kept in view: when it or the open file changes, the body scrolls just enough to show it (a line clear of the edge), at once; the page never scrolls (code-block.logic.ts revealCurrentLine).

wrap.description: Long lines wrap (as in documentation): a wrapped line keeps its number on its first row. false: a line never wraps; the body scrolls sideways and the gutter (with a diff's accent bar) stays at the inline start, over an opaque background, as an editor's does. Defaults to false in the editor look.

editor.description: The body of an editor pane (VS Code, Zed): no frame, no shadow, no header, no copy and no path, because the host gives the file tabs; it fills its container's height (give the parent a height), code at 13px, lines do not wrap unless wrap is set. Shows lines, highlighted or diff; ignores files. Not for the command variant.

keyboard: Enter / Space on Copy copy the code; focus stays on the button
Tab reaches the code body while it overflows; the arrow keys and Page Up / Page Down scroll it
notes: Copy is named "Copy code"; its visible labels are aria-hidden. A visually hidden role=status region announces "Copied" politely and empties when the label reverts.
Line numbers are user-select: none, so selecting and copying by hand skips them.
The body is direction: ltr; code reads left to right in right-to-left pages.

motion: copy: icon and label crossfade with opacity and a 2px blur over duration.base; colour over duration.fast; press scales to motion.press-scale over duration.press
"Copied" holds for 1.5s, then crossfades back; with files it belongs to the file that was copied: opening another file shows Copy at once (no fade) and the status empties
current line: moves at once (no transition) and the body scrolls to it at once: it follows the caret, a high-frequency action
Tabs ↔ pager + select switch (width): no animation; nothing plays on first paint
wrap and editor: no motion; sideways scrolling is the browser's
